description: This file defines a custom JSON converter class 'DynamicJsonConverter' for serializing and deserializing dynamic JSON data structures, handling various JSON token types including null, boolean, number, string, array, and object.

classes.name: DynamicJsonConverter
classes.description: A custom JSON converter for handling dynamic JSON data types, capable of reading and writing various JSON token types.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads JSON data from Utf8JsonReader and converts it into corresponding C# objects, handling null, boolean, number, string, array, and object types.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a C# object into JSON format using Utf8JsonWriter.
